See AMC.343 (b)
(a) The disposable load combinations must include each fuel load in the range from zero fuel to the selected maximum fuel load. The zero fuel load does not include the unusable fuel remaining.
(b) If fuel is carried in the wings, the maximum allowable weight of the UAV without any fuel in the wing tank(s) must be established as "maximum zero wing fuel weight" if it is less than the maximum weight.
(c) Not applicable
